text:
Israeli-American couples: is it possible to satisfy MH's request to show a certificate of married status from a state that we did not get married in?

We told our clerk that in the U.S, marriage is only registered in the state we got married in (Utah), but she insisted we need to bring a document from the state my partner recently lived in.
When we insisted back, she said we can instead bring an affidavite from a lawyer about my partner's marriage status in the U.S. We don't understand this suggestion as we have an apostiled marriage certificate from Utah.
We are not sure what to do next...
